jobs.title: Data and AI Engineer
jobs.summary: This role turns AI research and experimentation into production grade solutions that deliver measurable business value. The engineer will own the full ML lifecycle from problem framing through deployment and monitoring while collaborating with product and data teams to ensure scalable and reliable AI systems.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Job title: Data and AI engineer Office location: Španskih boraca, Belgrade - Hybrid working (3 days in the office) About the role and the Team: We are looking for a Data and AI engineer to join our team and play a key role in turning emerging AI and machine learning capabilities into practical solutions that create measurable business value. We are looking for someone who can understand a business problem, determine whether AI/ML is an appropriate solution, build it, and help get it into production, working across the full AI/ML lifecycle. You will work closely with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Architects and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve processes, enhance customer experiences, reduce costs or support better decision-making. A key part of the role will be moving beyond experimentation and proof-of-concepts and helping to build reliable, scalable and production-ready AI solutions. You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of AI use cases and help shape how AI is adopted across the organisation. You'll be expected to understand both the technical possibilities and the underlying business problem, selecting appropriate approaches and measuring whether the solutions deliver the intended outcomes. What will you be doing? Design, train, validate, and deploy machine learning models across use cases. Integrate ML solutions into business systems (CRM, OSS, digital platforms, APIs) supporting both real-time and batch inference. Move models from experimentation into production via APIs, Kafka pipelines, and streaming architectures. Build and maintain MLOps pipelines covering CI/CD for models, versioning, deployment automation, and monitoring for model drift and performance degradation. Ensure reproducibility, traceability, and governance of models and experiments. Collaborate with Data Engineers to define scalable data pipelines and feature engineering logic. Design, implement, and operationalise AI pipelines including LLM integrations (API-based and self-hosted), retrievalaugmented generation (RAG) systems, embedding workflows, and agentic AI automation using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI. Build reusable AI components and maintain model registries, prompt libraries, and evaluation datasets. Establish evaluation frameworks, observability tooling, and guardrails to measure model quality, latency, and cost. Adhere to responsible AI practices including bias mitigation, explainability, transparency, and data privacy and security standards. Own production monitoring and incident response for AI/ML systems. Partner with stakeholders to translate business problems into AI/ML solutions with clear success metrics. Champion AI/ML best practices across the engineering organisation; contribute to internal standards, frameworks, and reusable components; and mentor colleagues engaging with AI/ML capabilities. Previous experience in software or data engineering, with experience in building, deploying, and operating ML models or AI systems in production. Strong programming skills in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) and experience with data platforms (AWS, Spark, SQL). jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.summary: Senior DevOps Engineer will build and operate production ready Azure platform foundations using Infrastructure as Code to enable secure scalable banking services. The role focuses on automating provisioning and CI CD pipelines and elevating platform reliability and compliance in regulated enterprise environments.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu At Tieto Banktech , we power some of the Nordics' most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable cloud solutions. We are on an exciting transformation journey-modernizing core banking through automation, infrastructure-as-code, AI, and cutting-edge Azure technologies. We are looking for Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure Infrastructure & Cloud Operations) to join our Platform Engineering team and help us build production-ready, resilient platform foundations with Terraform, automated deployment pipelines, and reliable cloud operations on enterprise scale. If you thrive in a talented, forward-leaning engineering team where people collaborate, challenge ideas constructively, and help each other grow, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact. Why You'll Love Working with Us High-Impact Work: Build and host mission-critical financial applications serving Nordic banking customers. Modern Engineering Standards: Full commitment to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), GitOps, and DevSecOps principles—no manual click-ops. True Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: We support a modern, hybrid work culture that respects your time and well-being. Culture of Continuous Learning: Technology moves fast, and so do we. We dedicate time and resources for unlearning, relearning, certifications, and mastering new technologies. Collaborative & Open Environment: Work closely with cross-functional architecture, security, and product development teams in a flat, supportive organization. Knowledge Sharing & Team Growth: Join a talented, forward-leaning Platform Engineering team where sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and helping others grow are part of how we work. SQL Linux JavaScript HTML Node Node.js Git Python Selenium Docker PostgreSQL REST HTTP Proxy TypeScript Kafka senior That's us: The Kaske Group, headquartered in Munich, provides data, software and AI solutions for companies in the healthcare and life sciences sectors. Since 1997, we have grown into an integrated platform provider, combining one of the largest digital healthcare databases in the DACH region with data-driven software, AI and consulting services. With more than 100 customers and projects across 22 European countries, we support our clients from strategic data analysis through to implementation. This role sits within Smile BI Devs, the Kaske Group’s software and analytics unit, where we develop data-driven products for the healthcare and life sciences industry. To strengthen the reliability and scalability of our crawling systems, we are looking for an experienced engineer who will expand our capacity, improve technical resilience and help prepare our platform for further international growth. Your mission: As our Staff Crawling Engineer, you will take end-to-end technical ownership of reliable, production-ready crawling solutions - from analysis and estimation through to deployment, monitoring and maintenance. You will: Design, build and maintain Node.js-based crawling and data-collection services for static, dynamic and JavaScript-rendered websites. Develop reliable crawling processes with appropriate concurrency, scheduling, retries, monitoring and failure recovery. Integrate crawling services with Kafka and downstream data-processing systems. Ensure the completeness, consistency, timeliness and quality of collected data. Diagnose and resolve production failures, website changes and performance issues. Provide realistic estimates and communicate assumptions, dependencies and delivery risks early. Contribute to architecture, code reviews and technical standards while improving testability, documentation and maintainability. Collaborate across engineering, product and business teams, share knowledge and mentor other engineers without formal people-management responsibility. Your profile: 10 years or more of professional software-engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated Staff-level capability. Substantial experience building and operating production web crawlers, web-scraping systems or comparable data-acquisition services. Advanced Node.js and JavaScript skills, including asynchronous programming, concurrency and event-driven processing. Strong knowledge of HTTP, HTML, DOM structures, APIs and dynamically rendered websites. Practical experience with browser-automation tools such as Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium. Experience designing reliable production processes involving queues, retries, rate limits, timeouts and failure recovery. Experience with SQL, relational databases, Git, Linux and Docker. Strong technical ownership, structured problem-solving and the ability to provide realistic estimates. Clear, proactive communication around assumptions, blockers, risks and changing timelines. Professional working proficiency in English. Nice to have: TypeScript or Python experience. Experience with Kafka and PostgreSQL. Knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring, alerting and observability.
